HOPE VETERINARY ONCOLOGY SERVICES IS PROUD TO BE AN INDEPENDENT PRACTICE.
Hope Veterinary
Oncology Services
Complete Pet Oncology Care Anywhere in the World
WHAT WE DO
Our mission at HVOS is to make high-quality, compassionate, and
fear free
®
cancer care more accessible to the South Puget Sound community.
WHY WE DO IT
We find fulfillment in trying to improve the quality of life of our patients, their families, and each other.
HOW WE DO IT
We strive to achieve this mission by:
Using our mobile veterinary oncology unit to serve multiple areas of the beautiful South Puget Sound
Being mindful of the challenges of caregiving and using that knowledge to care for ourselves so that we can care for others including our team-mates, our patients, and their families
Having each team member be fear free® certified
Paying our veterinary health care workers an appropriate wage for the incredibly hard and highly skilled work that they do
About Hope Veterinary Oncology Services
We believe that treating a patient is not just a matter of addressing their medical needs. Patients with cancer need more than direct cancer treatment. At
Hope Veterinary Oncology Services
,
we attempt to address needs such as nutritional support, immune function support, mobility issues, and emotional support for the family unit.
